children: Intapp (NASDAQ: INTA), the governed AI platform for professional firms in highly regulated industries, today announced the Intapp Profitability Network, a certified partner ecosystem that connects every stage of how a law firm earns and collects on a matter — from pricing and staffing through time capture, prebilling, and collections. Introduced at ILTACON 2026, the network launches with six founding partners: Capacity, EngageAI, Legora, Lexpipe, Oddr, and Zebraworks.

AI is now part of every firm's strategy. The next question is what that means for firm profitability. The answer runs through the matter — from the moment a firm prices an engagement to the last dollar collected. At every stage of the lifecycle — pricing, staffing, time capture, prebilling, invoicing, collections — profitability can improve or erode.

But most firms manage each stage in separate systems with separate teams, with no shared view of what's happening across the chain. Data clarity and insights are lost at every handoff. By the time a firm can see where margin leaked, it's too late to recover it. The Intapp Profitability Network changes that.

Intapp calls this Firm AI — the category of AI aimed not at the individual or the work product, but at the business of the firm itself. Horizontal assistants speed up everyday tasks. Practice AI helps produce the work product. Firm AI runs the business behind both. Profitability is where that difference shows up on the income statement.
The network connects the full chain.

For the first time, firms can see profitability as an unbroken chain, from the first pricing decision to the final dollar collected. Built on Intapp Time with Celeste and Intapp Billstream, the network links specialist partner capabilities into one governed system, not a collection of disconnected point tools that each see only part of the picture.
The network runs on the firm’s own economics.

Every firm can buy a pricing tool. What sets a firm apart is what its own matters actually cost to deliver — by phase, timekeeper, matter type, and AI tool usage. As clients begin asking how technology was applied to their work, that transparency becomes both a trust requirement and a pricing input. Intapp Time with Celeste captures that history, and the Profitability Network puts it to work in scoping, staffing, and repricing decisions.
Every integration is certified.

Intapp’s product and R&D teams review each network integration for security, API compatibility, and functional quality before it ships, with ongoing review as APIs evolve. For any workflow that touches timekeeping or prebilling, governed execution routes through Intapp Time with Celeste. Partners propose, analyze, and recommend, while Intapp governs, stores, and remains the platform of record.
Intapp Celeste orchestrates it.

Celeste, an expert AI coworker, runs agentic playbooks that span chain stages — surfacing budget drift during delivery before it becomes an unrecoverable write-down, flagging pricing variance, and connecting realization outcomes back to the pricing decisions that shaped them.
Founding network partners
The founding partners bring certified expertise to the stages of the chain that sit beyond Intapp’s core platform.
Capacity
Resourcing and staffing optimization

In a value-pricing model, staffing determines margin. The right timekeeper on the right matter is the difference between a profitable fixed fee and an underwater one. Capacity matches people to matters using utilization and billing performance data from Intapp Time with Celeste — not availability alone.
EngageAI
Engagement letter accuracy from scoping through signature

EngageAI connects to Intapp Intake and Terms so engagement letters reflect what was actually scoped and negotiated. Intake and Terms also natively integrate with DocuSign, giving risk professionals visibility and control throughout execution — not just at signature.
Legora
Governed AI legal workflows with structured time capture

Legora integrates Intapp Walls so AI workflows respect confidentiality and ethical wall boundaries. It also connects to Intapp Time, so any work lawyers do in Legora becomes a structured time entry rather than unbilled effort.
Lexpipe
Pricing intelligence and matter scoping analytics

Lexpipe connects to Intapp Time with Celeste, turning historical matter cost data into pricing models and fixed-fee baselines. Firms can scope new engagements against what comparable matters actually cost to deliver.
Oddr
Collections with full billing context from Intapp Billstream

Milestone fees, holdbacks, and success components create collections complexity that AR data alone can’t navigate. Oddr gives collections teams the context to understand why an invoice is disputed or delayed.
Zebraworks
End-to-end realization analytics

Zebraworks connects worked hours through billing to cash collected across every fee arrangement type. It answers the question managing partners increasingly ask: Are our value-priced matters actually more profitable than our hourly ones, and which clients, matter types, and fee structures should we price differently next time?
Availability

The Intapp Profitability Network is available now. Founding partner integrations will reach general availability throughout the fall, following completion of the Intapp certification program. Firms interested in connecting Intapp Time with Celeste and Billstream to network partners can contact their Intapp account team or visit
Supporting quote
Ken Houseman, Vice President and General Manager, Intapp Time

“Firm profitability has always been a chain problem, not a billing problem. Intapp Time with Celeste and Billstream govern the core of that chain; the network extends it, connecting the specialist capabilities that complete each stage in one system firms can rely on. The shift toward value pricing isn’t a trend firms can watch from a distance and address later — it's a structural change driven by AI on both sides of the client relationship. The firms that compete on value in the next decade are the ones building their data infrastructure now.”
